name: Juror Breastplate
body:
Price 18,000 gp; Aura faint divination; CL 5th; Weight 30 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This golden +1 breastplate is embossed with the holy symbol of a deity of justice and holds divinatory runes in a secret compartment. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Intimidate checks and can cast augury once per day. When the wearer uses detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, or detect law, at the beginning of her next turn after casting she gains information as if she had concentrated for 3 full rounds. Finally, if the wearer is an legendary inquisitor, she can store 1 use of an instantaneous office ability in the breastplate as if she were wielding a barrister weapon. The legendary inquisitor can then discharge the stored ability by hitting an opponent with an unarmed strike.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 9,000 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells augury; Special creator must have 5 ranks in Intimidate
